title: Deep Scan
summary: When the surface lies, ask for the longer answer.
body: Deep Scan asks the server for safer, richer context about machines, hazards, inventories, and route logic.
It is slower than a quick Lens glance, but it often explains blocked machines and unknown targets.
steps: Use Deep Scan when compact rows do not explain the problem.
Check Tutorial rows for the next practical action.
commonMistakes: Scanning only the machine, not its power path.
